race.comment: IRAMA (1) was well in the betting when resuming and didn't let backers down with a strong win around this circuit. Will have derived a stack of confidence from that victory and winning hoop Geran sticks in the irons. Can go back-to-back without surprising. OUT OF LUCK (9) just missed the frame at the Sunny Coast last time out and will be ready to peak now fourth run back from the spell. Looms as the main danger. LINWAR (8) boasts a win over this track and trip and will be rock-hard fit for this contest. Top-three credentials. ORIENTE (4) had to contend with a wide alley at his latest run and finished out of the placings over 1200m at Rockhampton. Next in line from the favourable draw.
